reasons.plausibility: The benefit of small carbon additions forming fine carbides to enhance both strength and ductility is thoroughly grounded in known metallurgical mechanisms, though the precise role of stacking-fault energy modification in a BCC system raises some uncertainty.
reasons.testability: A well-defined, relatively straightforward experiment measuring mechanical properties in carbon-doped vs. undoped alloys can directly confirm or disprove the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Refining precipitation via controlled carbon additions to improve strength–plasticity synergy addresses a pressing challenge in RHEA research, making it a promising and relevant approach.
